programme.title: Wildest Islands S1 - "Galapagos: Darwin’s Eden"
programme.desc: The Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world.

programme.title: Wildest Islands S1 - "Sri Lanka: Monsoon Island"
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Helmets, Tea, District Heating"
programme.desc: How do they harvest and treat the world's most expensive tea? Plus, how does the Siekierki power plant of Warsaw, Poland heat half the city's homes?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Royal Enfield, Art Fraud, Milk"
programme.desc: How do they engineer the latest incarnation of the classic Royal Enfield Continental GT motorbike? Plus, how do 'art detectives' spot a forgery?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crash Testing, Delftware, Umbrellas"
programme.desc: How do they blend science and destruction at crash test centres? And how do they piece together the complex mechanism of a pocket sized umbrella?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Iron Ore, Wave Flume, Chandeliers"
programme.desc: How do they extract iron ore from one of the most remote mines on the planet? And how do they make chandeliers that are fit for a queen?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Oyster Knives, Stadium Lights, Diamonds"
programme.desc: How do they forge the blades to crack open oyster shells? Plus, how do scientists in a lab grow the synthetic diamonds of the future?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Cheddar Cheese, CPR Mannequins, Dishwashers"
programme.desc: How do they make cheddar, the world's most popular cheese? How do they breathe life into Rususci Anne - the plastic woman that teaches CPR?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Ford Transits, Driza-bone, Saltfish"
programme.desc: How do Ford produce the ubiquitous white van, the Transit? Plus, how do they ensure the Driza-bone coat lives up to its name?

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Oceans"
programme.desc: Throughout history, human society has run on trade. The innovations that allowed faster and more accurate oceanic travel revolutionized the world. New inventions now help people and goods move on the water faster for recreation and commerce.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Recovering From Extinction"
programme.desc: How long does it take for life to rebound after a major mass extiction? Scientists in Svalbard dig through fossil clues for surprising revelations abour our Earth's history.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Miami Beach Underwater"
programme.desc: As scientific studies confirm sea level changes throught the globe, major coastal cities like Miami are now fighting back against these rising tides, before it's too late. Parts of Miami Beach are under serious threat, with major economic dangers.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Homo Naledi"
programme.desc: Discovering in 2013, new and puzzling finding of small-skulled fossils of Homo naledi have scientists trying to understand whether Homo sapiens lived at the same time as Homo naledi, and how Homo naledi communities may have lived.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "The Apollo Sale"
programme.desc: Torie’s son Jason joins her on the road. Larry turns ‘gastronaut’ when he comes across some space food; and a collector’s flash sale sees Cole bid for an Apollo 11 item with an incredible story.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Good Luck, Bad Luck"
programme.desc: Cole gets lucky when he finds a Russian space suit in an old box, but the gloves are missing. To find the gloves he has to strike a deal with Larry. Torie hears how Coke and Pepsi joined the space race and meets former NASA astronaut Winston Scott.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Tornadoes"
programme.desc: Explore with us the most destructive tornadoes in history, why could no one predict it?

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Crashes"
programme.desc: Join us as we investigate the worst plane, train and ship disasters of all time.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Man Made Disasters"
programme.desc: Explore with us how a manmade disaster could be as much destructive as some natural disaster.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Kyrgyzstan’s Space School"
programme.desc: In a country where girls are often kidnapped and forced to marry, a defiant all-girls space-tech school are building Kyrgyzstan’s first satellite.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Ecuador’s Hidden Treasure"
programme.desc: Three women scientists take on Ecuador’s endangered spider monkeys and empower indigenous women, in a scientific area usually dominated by men.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "From The Lab To The Field"
programme.sub-title: From The Lab To The Field
programme.desc: From the laboratory to Africa, Dr Sheila Ochugboju takes her scientific knowledge to Kenya turning parasitic problems into scientific solutions.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Dolphin Sanctuary"
programme.desc: Anastasia Miliou and her team of women scientist are building a sanctuary in Greece for dolphins released from captivity, the first of its kind.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Wind"
programme.desc: This film follows the race to generate vast power from thin air - the wind. One of the world's biggest windfarms is being built off the English coast.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Aviation"
programme.desc: The way we fly about to change, driven by a new breed of aviators not afraid to think differently. Could the days of the jet age be numbered?

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Fusion"
programme.desc: It is the greatest technological challenge ever undertaken by humankind. The quest to produce the ultimate energy solution... fusion.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Tidal"
programme.desc: The power of the ocean's tides is the last great untapped energy source on Earth. Teams of engineers race to perfect the technology to harness the vast flowers of water.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Extreme Buildings"
programme.desc: Throughout history, our ancestors have always strived to go higher, bigger, deeper, further - and this is reflected in the buildings and structures around our globe. But what secrets can these ancient structures reveal?

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
programme.sub-title: Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
programme.desc: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programme.sub-title: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
programme.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.sub-title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programme.sub-title: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programme.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot"
programme.desc: The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot was an aerial battle in the Western Pacific where the U.S. successfully shot down over 300 Japanese aircraft with a 12-1 kill-to-loss ratio.
